# Maison Aurelia

> Discover luxury lab diamond rings, necklaces, earrings and tennis bracelets, plus modern gold jewelry curated from Omara and Hey Happiness.

This site publishes buying guides and product recommendations. Some links are affiliate links; see the affiliate disclosure page.

## Pages
- [Lab Diamond Rings, Necklaces & Gold Jewelry](https://jewllery.store/): Discover luxury lab diamond rings, necklaces, earrings and tennis bracelets, plus modern gold jewelry curated from Omara and Hey Happiness.
- [How to Select a Lab Diamond Ring: Cuts, Settings & Metals](https://jewllery.store/best-lab-diamond-rings.html): How to choose a lab-grown diamond ring: shape, setting style, metal, ring size and practical wear for everyday life.
- [Choosing Diamond Earrings: Studs, Hoops & Backings](https://jewllery.store/diamond-earrings-guide.html): How to choose diamond earrings: studs vs hoops, carat size per ear, settings and secure backings for everyday and occasion wear.
- [Gold Hoop Earrings: Size, Finish & Closure Guide](https://jewllery.store/gold-hoop-earrings.html): How to choose gold hoop earrings: diameter, thickness, solid vs plated gold, finish and closure types for everyday comfort.
- [Jewelry Gift Guide: Meaningful Picks by Budget](https://jewllery.store/jewelry-gift-guide.html): A jewelry gift guide by budget and occasion, with tips on sizing, delivery timing, gift packaging and returns.
- [Lab-Grown Diamond Buying Guide: 4Cs & Certification](https://jewllery.store/lab-diamond-buying-guide.html): How to buy a lab-grown diamond: the 4Cs, certification, cut quality and how to compare stones beyond carat weight.
- [Tennis Bracelet Guide: Stones, Clasps & Sizing](https://jewllery.store/tennis-bracelet-guide.html): How to choose a diamond tennis bracelet: stone consistency, carat weight, setting, clasp security and how to size it correctly.
- [Guides & buying advice](https://jewllery.store/blog/): Independent buying guides from Maison Aurelia about diamond and modern jewelry: who each option suits and what to check before you buy.
- [Best Sterling Silver Ear Cuff for Sensitive Ears](https://jewllery.store/blog/sterling-silver-ear-cuff-for-sensitive-ears.html): Find the best sterling silver ear cuff for sensitive ears with hypoallergenic picks, buying tips, and comparisons to help you choose confidently today.
- [Best Modern Layered Necklace for Everyday Wear](https://jewllery.store/blog/modern-layered-necklace-for-everyday-wear.html): Find the best modern layered necklace for everyday wear, from waterproof chains to beaded strands, with honest buying tips and trusted retailer picks.

- [About Maison Aurelia](https://jewllery.store/about.html): Maison Aurelia is an independent editorial guide to lab-grown diamond fine jewelry and modern gold essentials, with transparent affiliate links.
